detail.title: Intex ThunderCool HC 60 Desert Air Cooler | 60 Litres Capacity
detail.overview: The Intex ThunderCool HC 60 Desert Air Cooler is designed for efficient and reliable cooling in small to medium-sized rooms. With a 60-litre water tank, it delivers consistent cooling performance while remaining energy efficient. The cooler features 4-way air deflection to evenly distribute cool air across the room, ensuring all-round comfort. Equipped with a high-performance double ball bearing motor and 3-speed airflow control, the HC 60 allows customized cooling based on your comfort needs. Its inverter-compatible design ensures uninterrupted cooling during power cuts, while the shock and rust-proof body enhances durability. Easy mobility is ensured with 360° moving wheels, making it a practical choice for everyday summer cooling.
